what: naive discrete SC pressure-tensor route for sigma vs Laplace sigma
formula: sigma = int (P_rr - P_tt) dr, P_ab = rho c_s^2 d_ab + (G_eff/2) sum_i w_i (psi psi') e_ia e_ib
verdict: FAIL - none of the three naive tensor variants reproduces the Laplace sigma (46-126% deviation); reported as an honest negative cross-check, NOT used in the accuracy verdict. Cause: the one-sided/naive SC pressure tensor is not divergence-consistent on D2Q9 (fourth-moment anisotropy across a W~4 interface); a divergence-consistent (gradient-corrected) tensor would be needed, which is out of scope here (library must not be modified).
